question: Should unconditional MCP command-family declaration land after focused proof of the one-time approval path for nodes paired on older versions?
rationale: The fix is correct for fresh pairing and hot-plugging, but it intentionally changes the declared command surface of every upgraded headless node and may require operator approval; repository policy treats that compatibility behavior as a maintainer-owned merge decision.

options.title: Require upgrade proof
options.body: Add a focused test or live transcript showing the old pairing, one pending admin upgrade, unaffected existing commands, approval, and stable reconnect before merge.

options.title: Accept documented upgrade behavior
options.body: Land with the existing documentation and live hot-plug proof, explicitly accepting that upgraded nodes may require one administrator approval.

recommendation.title: Require upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Add a focused test or live transcript showing the old pairing, one pending admin upgrade, unaffected existing commands, approval, and stable reconnect before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the node-hosted MCP pairing behavior and owns the recent implementation and proposed correction.
